audio_music: A bass-boosted, high-energy, electronic version of "The Star-Spangled Banner" plays throughout, creating a hype or patriotic mood that contrasts with the mocking central message.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single static image.
manipulation_or_satire: The post is a composite meme image. A 3x3 grid of photos of US Presidents is assembled, and text is superimposed over each photo. On eight of the photos, the text collectively reads 'THANK YOU ALL FOR CARING ABOUT OUR COUNTRY.' The central photo, featuring Donald Trump, has the text 'NOT YOU' superimposed to single him out for mockery.
central_claim: Donald Trump, unlike numerous other presidents from both parties, does not care about the United States.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as an unpatriotic outlier in the history of the American presidency and to generate disapproval of him.
